content: In use cases requiring the introduction of a new task, users can use class inheritance to build on a number of available parent task types including classification, tagging, span prediction, span classification, sequence generation, regression, ranking, and multiple choice task classes. For these task types, corresponding task-specific output heads are already implemented.
